experience.title: Software Engineer
bullets: Framework migration. Led upgrade of Spring Boot 2.6 → 3.5, Spring Security 6 and Jakarta EE migration across 20 Java modules; resolved dependency conflicts, deprecated APIs, and behavioral changes while keeping the build green.
REST API design. Designed and implemented REST APIs with pagination, filtering, and audit metadata; introduced optimistic concurrency controls to prevent conflicting updates.
gRPC contracts. Defined backward-compatible gRPC service contracts using Protocol Buffers and maintained contract-style tests for cross-service compatibility.
MongoDB optimization. Optimized data access with targeted indexes and bulk read patterns; batched audit retrieval to reduce database round trips and improve report generation times.
Full-stack delivery. Built configuration and reporting workflows in Ember.js with TypeScript, adding reusable components and validation logic.
CI/CD and deployment. Used GitHub Actions build, test, and deployment workflows; deployed services through the available UI to AWS ECS/Fargate. Did not design or administer AWS infrastructure.

AI-assisted engineering. Used GitHub Copilot and agent-assisted workflows to accelerate implementation, root-cause analysis, debugging, and test scenario design, while owning design decisions and validation.
